svg.title: Lab 07 Order Queue Desk architecture
svg.desc: GCP project, global services, regional Cloud Run workloads, Direct VPC Egress, private Cloud SQL over PSA, Pub/Sub and operational resources.
svg.text: Lab 07 • asynchronous order processing with business-level idempotency
Dedicated Lab project • no public Cloud SQL IP
asia-southeast1 • regional services and customer network
PSA private IP • no public IP
Blue: customer HTTPS • Teal: private SQL path through Direct VPC Egress and PSA. Queue and Scheduler directions are in the companion flow diagram.
Secret versions are numeric; image references use digests. Secret Manager is global with an Asia replica, not a regional access boundary.
